约 2.5MB · 零权限 · 支持 Android 7.0+ · 适配沉浸全屏。v1.3.62：① 雪山重制，旧版是 7 座 ConeGeometry 圆锥加 FBM 位移，没有山脊也没有雪线；现改为极坐标环形地形带（RingGeometry 天生建在 XY 平面、可直接把 z 当高度，契合本项目 Z-up 坐标系），r=26~120 六层递进加密，四层噪声叠出大尺度骨架 / ridged 折痕山脊 / 中尺度沟壑 / 高频碎石，极坐标拉伸笛卡尔域采样保证 θ=0 与 2π 天然重合无接缝。② 天际线此前是条直线（起伏仅 0.63°）—— 沿任意方位角射线都会撞到山脊、峰顶仰角收敛到同一渐近值，新增方位角振幅掩码（含缓慢径向漂移，避免像风车叶片）后升到 5.83°。③ 山体发灰死白：地形用 Lambert 材质、顶点色里已烘焙过一遍太阳，接着又吃场景真实光照（≈2.53 辐照度），光照算两遍全过曝；改用 MeshBasicMaterial + toneMapped:false 直接输出显示空间颜色，绕开 ACES（实测其灰阶响应把线性 0.5 以上全压到 194+，动态范围尽失），亮度标准差 8 → 40.7。④ 雾把山压平：scene.fog 按视空间深度混合，可见山体几乎全在雾化区间，改为顶点色烘焙大气透视（smoothstep(28,118) × 0.35 混天色），scene.fog 推远到 (70,320)。⑤ 岩石按「坡度 × 雪线」双重判定，峰顶无论多陡都保持雪白，不再是一堵黑石墙。⑥ 远裁剪面放大到 165，8 场景 × 2 视角全量回归、零 JS 报错、球桌始终占据画面主体。⑦ 修掉严重既有缺陷：俯视模式球桌被整个盖住（台呢占比 0%）—— 背景房间盒子地板悬在球桌上方 1.2m，让地板对齐球桌底沿后恢复到 68%，瞄准视角不受影响。点击下载后到"下载"目录点击安装。~2.5MB · Zero permissions · Android 7.0+ · Immersive fullscreen. v1.3.62: (1) Snow range rebuilt — the old scene was seven FBM-displaced cones with no ridgelines and no snow line; it is now built from polar terrain bands (RingGeometry lives in the XY plane so z maps straight to height, matching this project's Z-up world), six progressively denser bands spanning r=26~120, with four noise layers for the large-scale skeleton, ridged creases, mid-scale gullies and high-frequency scree; sampling in a polar-stretched Cartesian domain makes θ=0 and θ=2π land on the same point, so there is no seam. (2) The skyline used to be a straight line (only 0.63° of variation) because a ray along any azimuth always hits a ridge, so peak elevation converged to the same asymptote everywhere; an azimuthal amplitude mask (with slow radial drift so it does not look like a fan blade) lifts it to 5.83°. (3) The peaks washed out: the terrain used a Lambert material while its vertex colours already had the sun baked in, then it received the real scene lighting on top (~2.53 irradiance) — lighting counted twice, everything blew out. It now writes display-space colours directly via MeshBasicMaterial with toneMapped:false, bypassing ACES (measured: ACES crushes everything above linear 0.5 into 194+, destroying dynamic range); luminance spread 8 → 40.7. (4) Fog flattened the range: scene.fog blends by view-space depth and nearly all visible terrain sat inside it; aerial perspective is now baked into vertex colours (smoothstep(28,118) × 0.35 toward the sky colour) and scene.fog pushed out to (70,320). (5) Rock is now gated by slope AND snow line, so summits stay white no matter how steep. (6) Far plane raised to 165, verified across 8 scenes × 2 cameras with zero JS errors and the table always dominating the frame. (7) Fixed a serious long-standing defect: the top-down camera could not see the table at all (0% cloth) because the background room's floor hung 1.2m above it; aligning the floor with the table base restores 68%, with the aiming view unaffected. v1.3.62v1.3.62当前版本 · 雪山重制 · 俯视遮挡修复Current · snow range rebuilt, top-down occlusion fixed
v1.3.62 · 雪山场景重制为程序化极地山脊；远裁剪面放大到 165 并全量实测不干扰游戏视角；顺带修掉「俯视模式根本看不到球桌」的严重既有缺陷；另清理 500 行死代码
· 旧版为什么不像雪山：buildSnowMountain() 用「旋转 -90° 的 ConeGeometry + FBM 位移 + 按高度渐变顶点色」造山，本质是几个尖顶，没有山脊线、没有鞍部、没有雪线。新版 buildSnowMountainV3() 改为极坐标环形地形带 —— RingGeometry 天生建在 XY 平面，可直接把 z 当高度，与本项目的 Z-up 坐标系天然契合；从球桌外缘 r=26 铺到 r=120，共 6 层递进加密。
· 四层噪声叠出山脊：基础 fbm 定骨架 → ridged 变换 1-|2·fbm-1| 折出尖峭脊线（雪山区别于丘陵的关键，普通 fbm 处处圆滑） → 细节层补沟壑 → 微地形只加 ±0.028 高频起伏、纯粹为了掠射角的阴影颗粒感。采样用极坐标拉伸笛卡尔域（u=cos(θ)·r·k、v=sin(θ)·r·k），θ=0 与 2π 天然重合，无接缝。
· 天际线死平的根因：第一版轮廓是一条水平直线（起伏跨度仅 0.63°）。因为沿任意方位角的射线都会撞到山脊，径向振幅随 r 单调饱和，各方向峰顶仰角收敛到同一渐近值 —— 数学上就注定是直线。新增 snowAzMask() 方位角振幅掩码（含缓慢径向漂移，避免像风车叶片），把各方向高度乘 0.35~1.45 倍，跨度升到 5.83°。
· 山体发灰死白：光照算了两遍 + ACES 压掉动态范围。地形原用 MeshLambertMaterial，而顶点色里已烘焙过一遍太阳，接着又吃场景真实光照（sun 1.8 + hemi 0.55 + ambient 0.32 ≈ 2.53 辐照度），反照率 0.5 以上全部过曝，实测亮度标准差只有 8。改为 MeshBasicMaterial + toneMapped:false + fog:false，顶点色即最终显示色。必须绕开 ACES：实测其灰阶响应为「线性 0.45→188、0.70→211、0.95→223、1.50→236」，0.5 以上全被压到 194+。改用显示空间着色：out = albedo × (AMB + SUN × pow(max(0,N·L), GAMMA))，明暗完全可控，标准差 → 40.7。
· 雾把山压平：scene.fog 按视空间深度线性混合，可见山体（r=26~120）几乎全在原 Fog(30,250) 区间内，明暗差被整体压缩（中位数被抬到 196、p90 只有 215）。改为地形 fog:false + 顶点色烘焙大气透视 （smoothstep(28,118,r) × 0.35 混天色）：近景完全不加雾、远山最多 35%，保住对比又留住纵深；scene.fog 推远到 (70,320)。
· 岩石不能只看坡度：第一版高山方向坡度到 1.3（52° 崖壁）时整片判成岩石，比天空还暗，画面顶部糊成黑石墙。改为「坡度 × 雪线」双重控制 rock = slopeRock × (1 - smoothstep(0.3, 0.62, hT)) —— 陡坡出露岩石，但峰顶保持雪白。岩石色由 0x39424d/0x66727e 提亮到 0x4d5763/0x7b8794（原色远看像破洞）。背光面死黑靠 AMB 0.26→0.29（雪面互反射，物理合理）+ SUN 提到 1.15 解决，亮部削到纯白 255 压过天空。
· 天穹渐变此前根本没生效：渐变停靠点写死在 z/r ∈ [0.22, 0.55]，而玩家实际能看到的天空只占 z/r ∈ [0, 0.036]（2° 仰角以内），整段渐变在视野之外 → 看到的就是一块纯色。停靠点改为参数 stops，雪景传 [0.01, 0.04] 并换用更冷冽的三档配色。
· 远裁剪面放大到 165 的安全验证（用户要求自行测试「能实际看到场景且不影响正常游戏视角」）：SNOW_FAR = 145 + 20 = 165，非雪景仍为 R×1000 ≈ 32.8。8 场景 × 2 视角全量回归：瞄准视角台呢 54.4%~91.7%、俯视 67.2%~80.3%，零 JS 报错，球桌在所有场景所有视角下都占画面主体。雪景瞄准视角：台呢 67.1% + 天空雪山 23.4%，环境只做背景不喧宾夺主。
· 顺带修掉严重既有缺陷：俯视模式球桌被整个盖住。beach / room / office / cybercafe 四场景俯视完全看不到球桌（台呢 0%）。根因在 assets.ts 的「背景房间盒子」：BoxGeometry 缩放 (80,40,30)、位置 z=16 → 占 z∈[1,31]，而球桌在 z≈0、俯视相机在 z=5.363（盒子内部），房间地板（z=1）正好悬在球桌上方 1.2m。讽刺的是它在瞄准视角下根本不可见（相机 z=0.295 在盒子下方，BackSide 全部剔除）—— 唯一生效的地方就是制造遮挡。修复：把 GROUND_Z（球桌底沿 -0.203）导出，房间 z 偏移改为 GROUND_Z + 15 = 14.797。俯视台呢 0% → 68.2%~68.8%，瞄准视角 39.7% → 39.6%（无影响）。
· 清理 500 行死代码：旧版 buildSnowMountain() 自 V3 上线后零调用，其整条私有链 makeMountainCluster / buildMountainMeshes / buildGlacierCanyon / applyFbmDisplace / paintRockSnowVertices / paintSnowCapVertices 一并删除（sceneenvironment.ts 1415 → 915 行），零残留引用、零孤儿常量。另清理 dist 下 4 个调试期临时产物。
· 约束与验证：只动 sceneenvironment.ts 的地形/天空/岩石构建与着色、view.ts 的雪景 fog 与远裁剪面、assets.ts 的房间 z 偏移；不碰物理引擎、碰撞参数、规则判定、回放逻辑、音效与 UI。webpack 构建通过，tsc --noEmit 保持 30（全为既有遗留，无新增）。 v1.3.62 · The snow scene is rebuilt as a procedural polar range; the far plane is raised to 165 and verified across every scene so it never interferes with gameplay; a serious long-standing defect that hid the table entirely in the top-down view is fixed; 500 lines of dead code removed
· Why it never looked like a mountain: the old builder rotated a ConeGeometry by -90°, displaced it with FBM and tinted vertices by height — a handful of spikes with no ridgelines, no saddles and no snow line. buildSnowMountainV3() now builds polar terrain bands instead: RingGeometry is constructed in the XY plane, so z maps straight to height — a natural fit for this project's Z-up world. Six progressively denser bands span r=26 (just past the table) to r=120.
· Four noise layers carve the ridges: base fbm for the skeleton → a ridged transform 1-|2·fbm-1| folds sharp creases into it (this is what separates an alpine range from rolling hills; plain fbm is smooth everywhere) → a detail octave for gullies → a micro layer adding only ±0.028 of high-frequency relief, purely for grain in grazing light. Sampling uses a polar-stretched Cartesian domain (u=cos(θ)·r·k, v=sin(θ)·r·k) so θ=0 and θ=2π land on the same point — no seam.
· The skyline was mathematically flat: the first version produced a horizontal line (only 0.63° of variation) because a ray along any azimuth always hits a ridge. With radial amplitude saturating monotonically, the elevation of the highest peak converged to the same asymptote in every direction. A new snowAzMask() azimuthal amplitude mask (with slow radial drift so it does not read as a fan blade) scales heights 0.35~1.45× per direction, lifting variation to 5.83°.
· The peaks washed out: lighting applied twice, then ACES ate the dynamic range. The terrain used MeshLambertMaterial while its vertex colours already had the sun baked in, and then it received the real scene lighting on top (sun 1.8 + hemi 0.55 + ambient 0.32 ≈ 2.53 irradiance), blowing out anything above 0.5 albedo — measured luminance spread was just 8. It now writes final display colours directly via MeshBasicMaterial + toneMapped:false + fog:false. Bypassing ACES is essential: measured response is "linear 0.45→188, 0.70→211, 0.95→223, 1.50→236" — everything above 0.5 collapses into 194+. Shading now happens in display space: out = albedo × (AMB + SUN × pow(max(0,N·L), GAMMA)). Luminance spread → 40.7.
· Fog was flattening the range: scene.fog blends by view-space depth, and nearly all visible terrain (r=26~120) sat inside the old Fog(30,250), compressing all contrast (median lifted to 196, p90 only 215). Aerial perspective is now baked into vertex colours (smoothstep(28,118,r) × 0.35 toward the sky colour): near ridges get no haze at all, far peaks at most 35%, keeping contrast while preserving depth. scene.fog is pushed out to (70,320) for the remaining objects.
· Rock cannot be keyed on slope alone: at slope 1.3 (a 52° cliff) the first version painted the whole face as rock, darker than the sky — a black wall across the top of the frame. Rock is now gated by slope AND snow line: rock = slopeRock × (1 - smoothstep(0.3, 0.62, hT)), so steep faces expose rock but summits stay white. Rock tints were lifted from 0x39424d/0x66727e to 0x4d5763/0x7b8794 (the old values read as holes from a distance). Dead-black backlit faces were fixed by raising AMB 0.26→0.29 (physically sound: snow bounces a lot of light) and SUN to 1.15, with highlights clipped to pure white so snow out-reads the sky.
· The sky gradient never actually showed: its stops were hard-coded at z/r ∈ [0.22, 0.55], but the sky a player can actually see spans only z/r ∈ [0, 0.036] (within about 2° of elevation) — the entire gradient sat outside the view, leaving a flat colour. The stops are now a stops parameter; the snow scene passes [0.01, 0.04] with a colder three-stop palette.
· Far plane raised to 165 — verified, not assumed (the user explicitly asked to confirm the scenery is actually visible and that gameplay views are unaffected): SNOW_FAR = 145 + 20 = 165, while other scenes stay at R×1000 ≈ 32.8. All 8 scenes × 2 cameras regression-tested: aiming view cloth 54.4%~91.7%, top-down 67.2%~80.3%, zero JS errors, with the table dominating the frame everywhere. In the snow scene's aiming view: cloth 67.1% + sky/peaks 23.4% — scenery stays in the background.
· Bonus fix: the top-down camera could not see the table at all. In beach / room / office / cybercafe the top-down view showed no table whatsoever (cloth 0%). Root cause: the "background room" box in assets.ts — a BoxGeometry scaled (80,40,30) at z=16, i.e. occupying z∈[1,31], while the table sits at z≈0 and the top-down camera at z=5.363 (inside the box). The room's floor (z=1) hung 1.2m directly above the table. Ironically the box is completely invisible in the aiming view (the camera at z=0.295 is below it and BackSide culls everything) — so occlusion was the only thing it ever did. Fix: GROUND_Z (table base, -0.203) is now exported and the room offset is GROUND_Z + 15 = 14.797. Top-down cloth 0% → 68.2%~68.8%; aiming view 39.7% → 39.6% (unchanged).
· 500 lines of dead code removed: the old buildSnowMountain() had zero callers since V3 shipped, so its entire private chain — makeMountainCluster / buildMountainMeshes / buildGlacierCanyon / applyFbmDisplace / paintRockSnowVertices / paintSnowCapVertices — is gone (sceneenvironment.ts 1415 → 915 lines) with zero leftover references and zero orphaned constants. Four debug-time artefacts were also cleaned out of dist.
· Constraints & verification: only the terrain/sky/rock construction and shading in sceneenvironment.ts, the snow fog and far plane in view.ts, and the room z offset in assets.ts were touched; no physics, collision parameters, rules, replay logic, audio or UI. webpack build passes; tsc --noEmit stays at 30 (all pre-existing, none new).
v1.3.61v1.3.61当前版本 · 台呢织物化 · 木纹桌框 · 13 款主题Current · fabric-grade cloth, wood-grain frames, 13 themes
v1.3.61 · 台球桌外观全面升级：找到「素」的主因（台呢材质无贴图），台呢织物化 + 无缝绒面底纹 + 木纹桌框 + 新增 2 款主题 + 回放桌同步主题
· 「素」的主因：解包 p8.min.gltf / snooker.min.gltf，cloth 材质只有 baseColorFactor 纯色、无任何 baseColorTexture；而 5 款经典主题 clothTexture 恰好都是 "none"（不生成贴图），两层「素」叠在一起。
· 台呢底纹重做：旧版「对角线性渐变 + 4000 个 1.2px 噪点」—— 渐变非周期，RepeatWrapping 平铺 2×2 接缝突变；噪点每 6~7px 一个，放大后像脏点。新版周期函数逐像素生成（多组正弦叠加出明暗斑与编织起伏，平铺严格无缝），噪点 3.5 倍密度、1px、随机透明度。
· 经典 5 款补菱格压花暗纹（velvet）：两组正交斜线（周期整除画布 → 无缝），透明度 0.05，远看干净近看有织物压花细节。
· 桌框木纹：GLTF wood 材质同样无贴图。新增横向拉丝（正弦取整数周期 → 水平平铺无缝）+ 2 个径向节疤；发光主题跳过（金属/烤漆质感不合木纹）。getFrameTexture() 改为始终生成。
· 台呢升级 MeshPhysicalMaterial + sheen：织物的掠射角泛白（backscatter）是台呢质感核心，Standard 材质渲染不出来（像哑光塑料）；sheen 0.55，sheenColor 取台呢色向白偏移 35%。按原材质实例缓存；新实例继承 name="cloth"（否则二次换肤按名字路由匹配不到）；换肤时同步 sheenColor。
· 新增主题：「翡翠鎏金」（墨绿呢 + 金菱格网 + 金铆钉 + 鎏金框金边）、「紫夜流光」（深紫呢 + 洋红/青霓虹灯带 + 紫金框），共 13 款。
· 回放/图解桌同步主题：TableMesh.generateTable() 此前永远内置蓝紫色，与所选主题脱节；现同步台呢/库边色并挂绒面贴图。
· 验证：tsc --noEmit 保持 30（全为既有错）；webpack 通过（474 KiB）；不碰物理 / 碰撞 / 回放 / 规则判定。 v1.3.61 · Table look overhaul: root cause found (cloth material had no texture at all), fabric-grade cloth with seamless velvet shading, wood-grain frames, 2 new themes, replay table follows theme
· Root cause: the GLTF cloth material of the pool/snooker tables carries only a baseColorFactor—no baseColorTexture whatsoever—and the 5 classic themes had clothTexture="none" on top of that.
· Cloth base pattern redone: per-pixel periodic waves (large-scale shading + fine weave) tile strictly seamlessly; fibre noise 3.5x denser at 1px with random alpha (the old 4000 blotches read as dirt spatter).
· Classic 5 themes gain diamond-quilted velvet: two orthogonal line families (period divides canvas → seamless) at 0.05 alpha—invisible from afar, tactile up close.
· Wood-grain frames: GLTF wood also had no map; added sine streaks (integer periods → seamless horizontally) plus 2 radial knots; glowing themes skip grain (metal/paint, not wood). getFrameTexture() now always produces a map.
· Cloth upgraded to MeshPhysicalMaterial + sheen: the grazing-angle whitening (backscatter) that makes fabric read as fabric cannot be rendered by MeshStandardMaterial—hence the matte-plastic look. sheen 0.55, sheenColor = cloth color lightened 35%. Cached per original material instance; keeps name="cloth" for re-tint routing; sheenColor re-synced on theme change.
· New themes: Emerald Gilded (deep green + gold lattice + gilded frame) and Violet Nightglow (deep purple + magenta/cyan neon bands) — 13 in total.
· Replay/diagram table follows the theme now instead of built-in blue.

· 回放比分同步：v1.3.59 残留的 eventQueue / HUD 双重兜底。restoreScoreBefore() 已走 applyToController → base.handleScore → updateScoreHud 这条链，但跨段后 container.eventQueue 里残留的 StationaryEvent会在下一帧被 processEvents() 消费 → handleStationary → playNextShot(delay) → setTimeout(push HitEvent)，把刚重跑好的「应停在这一帧」状态再吃一次、推进到下一杆，让 HUD 看着像回到拖动前的数值。seekToFraction() 头部新增 eventQueue.length = 0，切断残留链路；restoreScoreBefore() 末尾再加一道兜底：直接 updateScoreHud(p1, p2, b, active) + 对 hud.p1Element / p2Element 写 textContent，即便上面那条链路任何一环被吞掉，HUD 数值仍与目标时刻一致。
· 俯视镜头：基本看不到白球走位，怎么改。v1.3.58 起 frameCameraForShot() 在 camTopDown === true 时直接 suggestMode(topView)，相机摆在桌桌正上方看 (0,0,0)，FOV 20°，白球只有几个像素。新增 Camera.topViewAtCenter(center, radius)：以本杆 focus（白球、被击球、对应球袋）几何中心为视线锚点，半径决定相机高度，pos = (center.x, center.y, center.z + radius·1.4/tan(fov/2))，看向 center。半径下限 R·1.5。圈越大相机越高，圈越小相机越低，白球在画面里始终够大、清晰。
· 斯诺克规则扩为 8 大要点：球与台（15 红 + 6 彩，开球架点位） · 开球（D 区、必先碰红、对手可「推杆」） · 阶段与交替（红球阶段 → 清彩阶段） · 计分与满分杆（理论 147 = 15·8 + 黄→绿→棕→蓝→粉→黑 27） · 置球点（彩球回自己的点、被占放最近、全占留袋内） · 自由球（犯规后声明、对手球当红） · 犯规（罚最高分值彩球 4~7 分） · 清彩顺序（黄→绿→棕→蓝→粉→黑，黑球入袋决定胜负） · 胜负（C·B·W 自然终局）。中英文双份。

· Replay score sync — defence in depth: clear the event queue + last-line HUD re-write. restoreScoreBefore() already drives applyToController → base.handleScore → updateScoreHud, but a stray StationaryEvent in container.eventQueue gets consumed by processEvents() the next frame, runs handleStationary → playNextShot(delay) → setTimeout(push HitEvent), and silently drags the picture forward to the next shot. seekToFraction() now empties eventQueue at the top (alongside clearTimeout(this.timer)), and restoreScoreBefore() ends with a defensive updateScoreHud(p1, p2, b, active) + a direct textContent write on hud.p1Element / p2Element, so the HUD always shows the score for the seek position even if some link in the chain was swallowed.
· Top-down camera — the cue ball was a few pixels, now a focused top-down with auto height. Since v1.3.58, frameCameraForShot() on camTopDown === true just called suggestMode(topView), placing the camera above the table origin at FOV 20°, so the cue ball collapsed to a handful of pixels. New Camera.topViewAtCenter(center, radius) anchors the view on this shot's focus (cue ball + object ball + pocket), with the camera at (center.x, center.y, center.z + radius·1.4/tan(fov/2)) looking at center; the larger the focus circle the higher the camera, so the cue ball and its path are always clearly visible.
· Snooker rules expanded to eight sections: balls & table (15 reds + 6 colours, frame layout) · the break (cue ball starts in the D, must strike a red first, push shot) · phases (red phase → colour phase, reds stay down, colours re-spotted) · scoring & the 147 (theoretical max = 15·8 + 27-colour run, real clearances land between 67 and 84) · re-spotting (back to your own spot, then nearest, then stay pocketed) · free ball (declare after a foul, treat another ball as red) · fouls (penalty 4–7 pt) · colour sequence (yellow → green → brown → blue → pink → black, black decides) · end of frame. Both languages.
· Environment scenes — unlock the football field and basketball court. The home-screen scene cards for football and basketball were disabled + "unavailable" badge. Now selectable. The original buildFootballField() / buildBasketballCourt() implementations are kept; football shrinks to 22×14 with four 3-tier × 2.5 m stands pulled in tight; basketball keeps 28×15 and brightens the floor (0xcaa05a → 0xd3a865) with the same tighter stands; snow stays as-is.
· Removed "Language" and "画面" from the in-game settings overlay. Same reason as the v1.3.58 (table skin) and v1.3.59 (cue theme + scene) removals: those rows duplicate the home-screen Settings panel. Deleted lines 411–434 of menu.html (the two .setting-group blocks) and the matching blocks in help.html; cleaned up the corresponding q, qh, and langSeg listeners in help-cn.js. Language switching is still driven by the home-screen Settings panel and pushed to the game page via the existing postMessage("billiards-language") channel from v1.3.19.
Constraints: replay seek logic + eventQueue clearing, the new topViewAtCenter method, menu/help DOM, snooker rule text, and environment scene geometry parameters only — no physics engine, collision model, rule-verdict logic or audio changes.

v1.3.59v1.3.59回放进度条不再卡死 · 音效按力度 · 斯诺克 12 尺Replay scrub fixed, force-scaled audio, 12ft snooker
v1.3.59 · 回放拖进度条不再卡死且比分正确回填、删除设置里的外观项、撞库声按力度分档、斯诺克桌放大到 12 尺
· 回放拖进度条：为什么会"卡死"——两个独立病根叠加。
· 病根 A（拖完就停）：seekToFraction() 里确定性重跑的循环是 while (table.time < localTarget && !allStationary())。跳转目标一旦超过本杆真实物理时长，循环提前退出，此时桌面已经静止；而 Container.advance() 推 StationaryEvent 的条件是 !stateBefore && allStationary() —— 必须由「运动」转为「静止」才触发。球在 seek 结束那一刻就已经是静止的，这个事件再也不会产生，于是 handleStationary() 永不执行，而它正是「球停后安排下一杆」的唯一入口。表现就是：进度条拖完画面停住，没暂停、没报错、UI 上也没有任何提示。修法是在 onSeekEnd() 之后调 resumeAfterSeek()——若此刻球已静止且队列里还有未播的杆，主动补一个 StationaryEvent，把断掉的链路接回去。
· 病根 B（进球数对不上）：this.shots 是一条被 shift() 逐条消费的队列，seekToFraction() 却只改了 currentShotIndex、没有重建队列。往回拖时已经播过的杆早被 shift 掉了，队列头部其实是「未来」的杆——于是往回拖会跳过若干杆、往前拖又会重播，而比分 HUD 靠队列里的 SCORE 事件推进，自然对不上。修法：构造时留一份 allShots 全量副本，并预计算 shotEventOffsets[k]（第 k 杆的 AimEvent 在全量序列中的下标）；跨杆跳转时按 off + 1 切片重建 this.shots（+1 是因为下面的 table.hit() 已经把本杆的 AimEvent 消费掉了，用 off 会让本杆再被完整重播一次），再用 restoreScoreBefore(off) 把该时刻之前最后一个 SCORE 事件回填到比分与当前击球方。
· 顺带修一个会让杆号串位的隐患：onSeekEnd 同时绑在 change 上，而键盘方向键 / 程序触发只走 input + change，不经过 onSeekStart。原来 clearTimeout(this.timer) 只写在 onSeekStart 里，于是杆间 delay 那个 timer 到期仍会 push HitEvent → beginShotBookkeeping() 把 currentShotIndex 再 +1，与刚设好的 idx 错开一位，后面每一杆的 meta 全部串位。现在 clearTimeout 提到 seekToFraction() 开头，任何入口进来的跳转都会先清 timer。
· 顺带修 handleBreak() 的漏复位：重新开球时此前没有重置 currentShotIndex = -1 与 shotMeta = []，会导致 shotEventOffsets 指向新序列、而 shotMeta 还留着上一局的，一并补上。
· 顺带修 precompute shot 0 failed——整局预计算此前一直是废的。回放启动时 precomputeAllShots() 会先在独立 simTable 上把每一杆预演一遍，好让进度条一开始就知道整局总时长。但 ShotMeta.cueballId 存的其实是 ball.id，而 ball.id 是全局自增编号——rules.table() 新建出来的桌球 id 是 48~63，与 balls 数组下标 0~15 根本不是一回事。取母球时写的却是 sim.balls[meta.cueballId]，即 balls[48] → undefined，紧接着 sim.hit() → Cue.hit(undefined) 抛 Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'state')。异常被 catch 后整局预计算作废（shotMeta 清空），进度条失去整局总时长，只能每播完一杆才追加一段。该字段的注释本来就写的是「本杆白球在 balls 数组中的下标」，属于注释与实现不符。现把字段改成 cueballIdx、两处赋值改为 balls.indexOf(cueball)、两处取值按下标走，预计算恢复正常（回放阶段控制台报错 1 条 → 0 条）。
· 删除游戏设置里的「外观与场景」分组（整组，含「球杆主题」与「环境场景」两行）。与 v1.3.58 删掉同组「台球桌外观」同样的理由：这些设置在首页都有专门入口，游戏内这一组是重复的。删除 menu.html 里 505–537 行整段 .setting-group，并同步删掉 menu-cn.js 里四处引用——syncSettingsUI() 对两个 select 的赋值、两个 change 监听、initCueThemes()/initScenes() 里往 syncActive 的回写。这四处必须一起删：前两处没有任何 null 保护，只删 HTML 会让 $("setCueTheme") 取到 null 并在初始化时直接抛 TypeError、菜单白屏。首页三个入口（环境场景 / 球杆主题 / 台球桌）原样保留。
· 撞库声此前几乎不随力度变化。REF_SPEED.Cushion 写的是 6 m/s，而这个值的语义是「撞库的典型速度上限」。实际撞库速度集中在 0.5~3 m/s（6 是按最大出杆速度 160R≈5.24 估的，可球撞到库边时早被台呢和库边吃掉大半动能）。归一化后 kk = speed/6 只落在 0.08~0.5，音量 = 0.3 + kk*0.7 → 实际只在 0.36~0.65 之间浮动；再叠上 ±8% 的增益抖动，两次不同力度的撞库在听感上根本分不出来。改动三条：① 参考速度 6 → 3.2（与 Pot 对齐），让 kk 用满 0~1；② 音量区间 [0.30, 1.00] → [0.18, 1.00]，轻撞明显更轻，不再被 0.3 的底噪垫成「怎么撞都一个响」；③ 播放速率由恒定的 1 改为 0.88 + kk*0.24——重撞更脆、轻撞更闷。真实台球的撞库音色亮度本来就随力度变化，之前完全没做，而手里只有 2 条同源素材，光靠音量差很难拉开层次，补上音高这个维度才真正分得开。速率抖动（±7.5%）是乘在 rate 上的，与力度调制叠加，不冲突。
· 落袋声偏小：0.5 + kk*0.5 → 0.65 + kk*0.35。落袋是最需要被听见的正反馈，而慢球滚进袋口时 kk 只有 0.2 左右、旧公式给到 0.6，环境音一盖就没了。下限抬高 30%，上限仍是 1.0 不削顶。
· 删除进球后的「成功」特效提示音。LIB 里去掉 success 条目，删掉 playSuccess() 方法本身，并清理 6 处调用点（drill / eightball / nineball / sagu / snooker / threecushion）。这条音效是叠在落袋音之后播放的，落袋音本身已经把「进了」这件事说清楚了，再叠一层叮咚纯属多余吵闹，连续进球时还会连着响。boteventhandler.ts 里给机器人用的桩对象也一并去掉 playSuccess() {}。
· 斯诺克桌：确认确实小了，默认由 10 尺改为 12 尺。斯诺克此前和八球/九球共用同一套台面 R*43 × R*21（R = 0.03275 m），换算约 2.82 × 1.38 m；而标准 12 尺斯诺克台是 3569 × 1778 mm，长度短了约 21%、宽度窄了约 23%。斯诺克球小、球多、袋口紧，台面一缩，开球堆球和长台走位全都变形。TableConfig.defaultTableSize() 现在按规则取值：斯诺克 12、其余保持 10。选 12 而不是 11 或 13，是因为 snooker.ts 的 tableModelStretchBySize 里已经有调好的 12: {x: 1420, y: 700}，而 GLTF 模型 models/snooker.min.gltf 本身就是按 12 尺建的——物理尺寸与模型拉伸直接对齐，不需要重新标定顶点缩放。
· 顺手修三处会把新默认值带偏的硬编码 10：recorder.getTableSize() 在录制回放时写死返回 10，回放里的桌面尺寸与实际对局不一致、回放会直接跑歪，改为按 container.rules.rulename 取；container.ts 的粒子系统同样改为按规则取；browsercontainer.ts 的重定向守卫原本拿 URL 的 tableSize 与硬编码 10 比较来决定是否重定向，斯诺克默认改成 12 之后会把正常的斯诺克局误判成需要重定向。
· 验证：浏览器端到端共 32/32 全过——斯诺克桌尺寸（物理台面放大 1.196×、视觉模型 1.173×，两者同步，模型与碰撞体没脱节）、回放进度条（拖回后未停在暂停态、继续推进、比分回填到该时刻应有的值并能重新累积回最终值）、设置面板（三个外观项已从游戏设置移除、首页三入口仍在、菜单未白屏）；回放阶段控制台报错 1 → 0 条。tsc --noEmit 错误总数保持 30（全部为既有错误，未新增语义错误）；webpack 构建通过（index.js 469 KiB）。
约束：只动回放跳转逻辑、菜单设置 DOM/JS、音效参数表与斯诺克桌尺寸，不碰物理引擎、碰撞模型、渲染管线与规则判定逻辑。 v1.3.59 · Replay scrubbing no longer freezes and the pot count is restored, appearance rows removed from settings, cushion audio scales with force, snooker table enlarged to 12 ft
· Why scrubbing "froze" — two independent root causes stacked on top of each other.
· Cause A (playback stops after a seek): the deterministic re-run loop in seekToFraction() is while (table.time < localTarget && !allStationary()). Once the seek target exceeds the shot's real duration the loop exits early — and at that point the balls are already at rest. But Container.advance() only pushes a StationaryEvent when !stateBefore && allStationary(), i.e. on a motion–to–rest transition. A table that is already still never produces that event again, so handleStationary() — the only entry point that schedules the next shot after the balls settle — never runs. The symptom: you drag the bar, the picture stops, nothing is paused, nothing is logged, no hint anywhere. Fixed with resumeAfterSeek(), called after onSeekEnd(): if the balls are already at rest and shots remain, push a StationaryEvent to rejoin the broken chain.
· Cause B (pot count stops matching): this.shots is a queue consumed one item at a time by shift(), yet seekToFraction() only set currentShotIndex and never rebuilt the queue. Seeking backwards, the shots already played had long been shifted off, so the head of the queue was actually a future shot — seeking back skipped shots, seeking forward replayed them, and the score HUD (driven by SCORE events in that same queue) drifted out of sync. Fixed by keeping a full allShots copy and precomputing shotEventOffsets[k] (the index of shot k's AimEvent in the full sequence); on a cross-shot seek the queue is rebuilt by slicing from off + 1 (+1 because table.hit() below has already consumed this shot's AimEvent — using off would replay the shot in full), and restoreScoreBefore(off) reapplies the last SCORE event before that point to the scoreboard and the active player.
· One off-by-one hazard fixed along the way: onSeekEnd is also bound to change, and keyboard arrows / programmatic seeks fire only input + change — they never go through onSeekStart. clearTimeout(this.timer) lived only in onSeekStart, so the inter-shot delay timer still fired, pushed a HitEvent, and beginShotBookkeeping() incremented currentShotIndex once more, leaving it one ahead of the idx just set and shifting every subsequent shot's meta. clearTimeout now sits at the top of seekToFraction(), so every entry point clears the timer first.
· Missing reset in handleBreak(): re-breaking never reset currentShotIndex = -1 or shotMeta = [], so shotEventOffsets pointed at the new sequence while shotMeta still held the previous game's. Both resets added.
· precompute shot 0 failed — whole-game precomputation had been dead all along. On replay start, precomputeAllShots() rehearses every shot on a separate simTable so the seek bar knows the total duration up front. But ShotMeta.cueballId actually stored ball.id, which is a globally incrementing identifier — a table freshly built by rules.table() hands out ids 48–63, which have nothing to do with balls indices 0–15. The lookup was sim.balls[meta.cueballId], i.e. balls[48] → undefined, and the very next sim.hit() → Cue.hit(undefined) threw Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'state'). The catch block discarded the entire precomputation (shotMeta cleared), so the bar lost the total duration and could only append a segment after each shot. The field's own doc comment already said "index of the cue ball in the balls array" — comment and implementation disagreed. The field is now cueballIdx, both assignments use balls.indexOf(cueball), and both lookups index directly; precomputation works again (replay console errors 1 → 0).
· Removed the "Appearance & Scene" group from in-game settings (the whole group: cue theme + environment scene). Same reasoning as removing the table-skin row in v1.3.58 — the home screen already has dedicated entries for these, so the in-game group was a duplicate. Deleted lines 505–537 of menu.html (the entire .setting-group) plus four references in menu-cn.js: the two select assignments in syncSettingsUI(), both change listeners, and the syncActive write-backs in initCueThemes() / initScenes(). All four had to go together: the first two have no null guard at all, so deleting only the HTML would make $("setCueTheme") null and throw a TypeError during init — a blank menu. The three home-screen entries (scene / cue theme / table skin) are untouched.
· Cushion impacts barely varied with force. REF_SPEED.Cushion was 6 m/s, but that value means "the typical upper bound of a cushion impact" — real ones land in 0.5–3 m/s (6 was estimated from the maximum shot speed 160R ≈ 5.24, forgetting that cloth and cushions eat most of that energy before the ball reaches a rail). Normalised, kk = speed/6 only spanned 0.08–0.5, so volume 0.3 + kk*0.7 moved between just 0.36 and 0.65; with ±8% gain jitter on top, two hits of very different force were indistinguishable. Three changes: (1) reference 6 → 3.2 (aligned with Pot), so kk uses the full 0–1; (2) volume range [0.30, 1.00] → [0.18, 1.00], so soft contacts are clearly softer instead of being floored into "every contact sounds the same"; (3) playback rate changed from a constant 1 to 0.88 + kk*0.24 — crisper on hard hits, duller on soft ones. Real cushion tone does brighten with force and that was simply never modelled; with only two source samples available, volume alone could not separate them, and adding pitch is what actually makes the difference audible. Rate jitter (±7.5%) multiplies onto the rate, so it composes with the force modulation rather than fighting it.
· Pot sounds were too quiet: 0.5 + kk*0.5 → 0.65 + kk*0.35. A pot is the one piece of positive feedback that must be heard, yet a slow ball rolling in has kk ≈ 0.2 and the old formula gave it 0.6, easily buried under ambience. The floor is 30% higher; the ceiling is still 1.0, so nothing clips.
· Removed the "success" jingle after a pot. Dropped the success entry from the sample library, deleted playSuccess() itself, and cleaned up all six call sites (drill / eightball / nineball / sagu / snooker / threecushion). It played on top of the pot sound, which already says "it went in" perfectly well — layering a chime on top was just noise, and consecutive pots made it chime repeatedly. The bot stub in boteventhandler.ts lost its playSuccess() {} too.
· Snooker table: yes, it really was too small — now 12 ft by default. Snooker had been sharing one table geometry with eight-ball and nine-ball: R*43 × R*21 (R = 0.03275 m), about 2.82 × 1.38 m. A standard 12 ft snooker table is 3569 × 1778 mm — so it was roughly 21% shorter and 23% narrower. Snooker uses smaller balls, more of them and tighter pockets, so shrinking the bed distorts the break and every long pot. TableConfig.defaultTableSize() is now per-rule: snooker 12, everything else stays 10. Twelve rather than eleven or thirteen because tableModelStretchBySize in snooker.ts already has a tuned 12: {x: 1420, y: 700} and the GLTF model models/snooker.min.gltf was authored at 12 ft — physics and model stretch line up with no need to re-calibrate vertex scaling.
· Three hardcoded 10s that would have defeated the new default: recorder.getTableSize() returned a fixed 10 when recording, so a replay's table size would not match the game it came from and the replay would diverge — now resolved from container.rules.rulename; the particle system in container.ts likewise; and the redirect guard in browsercontainer.ts compared the URL tableSize against a literal 10, which after this change would have mistaken every normal snooker game for one needing a redirect.
· Verification: end-to-end browser run 32/32 passed — snooker table size (physics bed 1.196×, visual model 1.173×, in step, so model and collider stay aligned), replay scrubbing (not left paused after a seek, keeps advancing, pot count restored to the value it should hold at that point and re-accumulating to the final score), settings panel (all three appearance rows gone from in-game settings, home-screen entries intact, menu renders). Replay console errors 1 → 0. tsc --noEmit stays at 30 errors (all pre-existing, no new semantic errors); webpack build succeeds (index.js 469 KiB).
Constraints: replay seek logic, settings DOM/JS, audio parameter tables and snooker table size only — no physics engine, collision model, render pipeline or rule-verdict logic was touched.
v1.3.58 · 回放机位锁定 · AI 难度重做 · 击球收杆v1.3.58 · replay camera lock, AI tiers rebuilt, cue retraction回放机位锁定 · AI 难度重做 · 击球收杆Replay camera lock, AI tiers rebuilt, cue retraction
v1.3.58 · 回放跟随视角每杆定位、AI 三档难度重做、击球后自动收杆等五项
· 回放跟随视角：病根是整条链路根本没接上。Replay.updateReplayCamera() —— 以及它下游的 camera.updateReplayFocus() → replayFrameView —— 一个调用者都没有。replayFrameHook 每帧只调了 tickSeekUI()，所谓"跟随"实际上做的是另一套逻辑：每帧把相机重新摆一遍，于是球一滚镜头就跟着飘，出杆瞬间还会整段平移。现已把 updateReplayCamera() 接进 replayFrameHook。
· 改用「锚点 + 有界微调」模型：playNextShot() 出杆前调 frameCameraForShot(aim)，用本杆的目标球/母球/袋口算出一次性机位锚点（REPLAY_ELEVATION = 0.72）并 forceMove() 直接落位，实现"每一杆击球前完成相机定位"；出杆后相机默认完全锁定，只保留由 setReplayNudge() 驱动的小幅偏移。
· 什么情况下才允许微调：allowReplayNudge() 三条任一成立 —— 本杆进球数 ≥ 2；本杆时长 > 2600ms（长链条）；当前时刻已超过首个进球 1200ms 且还没到末球进袋后 400ms（尾段节奏拖沓）。只有这几种情形才会去看"下一个即将进袋的球在哪"。
· 微调幅度严格封顶且平滑：偏航 ≤ 0.56rad（约 32°）、抬升 ≤ 14R、视点偏移 ≤ 12R，缓动系数 0.02（约 50 帧走完），绝不会剧烈跳转；微调的判据是把"待进袋球"投影到 NDC，超出 0.72 才回拉，球已在画面中央时一动不动。
· 下一杆重新完整定位：handleStationary() 里球全停后清掉 shotInFlight 与 nudge，setReplayFrame()/clearReplayFrame()/updateReplayFocus() 都会重置锚点；手动切视角按钮也改为走 frameCameraForShot()，保证与自动流程同一套定位。
· AI 难度：专业档此前是个"假档"。Professional.aim() 返回的是 [aimEvent, farKnuckleAimEvent, farKnuckleHit]，而只有数组最后一项 HitEvent 真正击球 —— 也就是说专业档每次出杆都是远库边全力的 farKnuckleHit，和激进档 TheFarJaw 一模一样；它那些候选枚举、切角排序、防落袋、自适应力度全部只作用于两个 AimEvent，而 AimEvent 只是预览（Controller.handleAim() 是空实现），对物理结果零影响。现已把真实出杆改成 pocketHit。
· 难度参数此前根本不存在：AimCalculator.generateShot() 的 noise 实参在全部 6 个调用点都被硬编码成 0；唯一的随机性是默认的 spinOffset = randomSpin()（±0.3 随机侧旋），可它只命中了最弱的稳健档（激进/专业都显式传了 Vector3）。rules.ts 里声明的 aiNoiseScale 从头到尾没人读。三档难度实际上只有"稳健 vs 其余"两档，且强弱关系还是反的。
· 新增 difficulty.ts 难度表：稳健 ClawBreak（瞄准噪声 0.030、力度抖动 12%、切角下限 cos 0.15，走位/防落袋/侧旋/自适应力度/安全球全关）；激进 TheFarJaw（0.010 / 5% / 0.20，开候选评估 + 防落袋 + 自适应力度）；专业 Professional（0.0015 / 0 / 0.34，全部能力开启）。力度抖动用均匀分布而非高斯 —— 高斯长尾偶尔会甩出离谱的力度。
· 专业档母球控制：新增 choosePower()（按距离分 55R/80R/100R/MAX，薄球 < cos0.5 打八五折，有落袋风险封顶 70R）与 chooseSpin()（落袋风险给 -0.35 低杆刹车；走位距离 > 6R 给 +0.3 高杆跟进、< 2R 给 -0.15 缩杆；薄球强制 ≤ -0.2），并给 estimateStop() 加了薄厚系数（travel = min(8R, (母球到目标球×1.1 + R) × (0.25 + 0.9×薄度))），母球分离距离的估算终于和切角挂上钩。
· 专业档不再出现低级失误：rankPlans() 按"不落袋 → 切角更直 → 走位更顺 → 不贴库 → 目标球离袋更近"排序；无解时走 safetyOrFallback() 打安全球（选接触后离对手球最远的目标），力度用 DEFAULT_SHOT_POWER 保证母球能吃到库，避免"没碰库"犯规。
· 顺手修一个显示 bug：browsercontainer.ts 只判了 TheFarJaw，选「专业」时开局提示会错显成"电脑 · 稳健"，现补上专业分支。
· 删除游戏设置里的「台球桌外观」。同一项设置在首页（#screen-tableskin）已经能改，两处读写的是同一个 settings.tableSkin、同一个 localStorage key，游戏内那一行纯属冗余。删除 HTML 那一行的同时必须删掉 menu-cn.js 里对应的 change 监听与初始化赋值 —— 否则 $("setTableSkin") 取到 null 会在启动时直接抛错。
· 球杆预览界面改版：标题（球杆主题名）居中显示，操作提示"单指拖动旋转 · 双指捏合缩放"缩小到 17px→11px 放在标题下方，右上角关闭按钮改为绝对定位不挤占标题空间，标题过长时省略号截断。放大范围放宽：ZOOM_MAX 1.4→1.6，缩小下限由固定的 0.35 改为按机位动态计算 max(0.25, (FIT_R + 0.2) / baseDist) —— 横屏 0.756→0.633（能多退 16%），竖屏 0.350→0.273（能多退 22%）。常数 SAFE_CLEAR = 0.2 是近裁剪面 0.1 的两倍，实测两个方向的安全余量都恰为 0.2000，球杆不会穿进相机。
· 击球后球杆不再停留在球桌上。此前 Cue.update() 里送杆动画在 t ≥ 3 之后 strokeX 就饱和不动了（杆停在 -4R 处），但 mesh.visible 一直为 true，于是从"击球瞬间"到"所有球停下"这整段时间里，球杆就这么横在台面上。现新增 retractAfterStroke()：t 达到 STROKE_END_T = 3（与击球曲线控制点最大 t 一致，正是真实台球里"击完即收杆"的时机）时隐藏球杆与杆影；aimMode()/placeBallMode()/hit() 复位。同时在 watchaim.ts、spectate.ts、replay.ts 三处进入下一杆瞄准时显式调 cue.aimMode() 把杆重新亮出来 —— 否则对手回合/回放里球杆会一直消失。
· 验证：浏览器冒烟测试 26/26 全过（覆盖上述五项）；tsc --noEmit 报错数 31→30（修掉 3 个既有问题，未引入新的语义错误）；webpack 构建通过（index.js 465 KiB）。
约束：只动回放相机、AI 策略与难度表、球杆预览 UI、设置面板 HTML/JS、球杆可见性，不碰物理引擎、碰撞参数、渲染管线与规则判定逻辑。 v1.3.58 · Replay camera framed per shot, AI difficulty tiers rebuilt, cue retracted after the stroke, and more
· Replay follow camera: the whole chain was never wired up. Replay.updateReplayCamera() — and everything downstream of it, camera.updateReplayFocus() → replayFrameView — had zero callers. replayFrameHook only called tickSeekUI() each frame, so what passed for "follow" was a different code path that re-framed the camera every single frame: the view drifted with the balls and translated wholesale the moment a shot was struck. updateReplayCamera() is now called from replayFrameHook.
· New "anchor + bounded nudge" model: before each stroke playNextShot() calls frameCameraForShot(aim), which builds a one-shot camera anchor from this shot's cue ball / object ball / pockets (REPLAY_ELEVATION = 0.72) and lands the camera with forceMove(). After the stroke the camera is locked apart from the small offset driven by setReplayNudge().
· When nudging is allowed: allowReplayNudge() returns true if the shot potted ≥ 2 balls, or the shot lasts > 2600 ms, or the clock has passed 1200 ms after the first pot and is still within 400 ms of the last — i.e. multi-pot shots, long chains, and slow tail ends.
· Nudges are capped and smooth: yaw ≤ 0.56 rad (~32°), lift ≤ 14R, look-at offset ≤ 12R, lerp factor 0.02 (~50 frames) — no jumps. The trigger projects the "next ball about to drop" into NDC and only pulls back beyond 0.72; a ball already centred leaves the camera alone.
· Full re-framing on the next shot: once the balls stop, handleStationary() clears shotInFlight and the nudge; setReplayFrame() / clearReplayFrame() / updateReplayFocus() all reset the anchor; the manual camera toggle now routes through frameCameraForShot() so it matches the automatic path.
· AI difficulty: the Professional tier was fake. Professional.aim() returned [aimEvent, farKnuckleAimEvent, farKnuckleHit], and only the last HitEvent actually strikes the ball — so Professional always shot full power at the far knuckle, exactly like the aggressive tier TheFarJaw. All of its careful work (candidate enumeration, cut-angle ranking, scratch avoidance, adaptive power) only affected the two AimEvents, which are previews — Controller.handleAim() is an empty implementation — and had zero effect on physics. The real shot is now pocketHit.
· Difficulty parameters did not exist at all: the noise argument of AimCalculator.generateShot() was hardcoded to 0 at all six call sites, and the only randomness was the default spinOffset = randomSpin() (±0.3 random side spin), which only ever hit the weakest tier because the other two pass explicit Vector3s. aiNoiseScale in rules.ts was declared and never read. In practice there were two tiers, not three, and the ordering was inverted.
· New difficulty.ts table: ClawBreak (aim noise 0.030, power jitter 12%, minimum cut cos 0.15, with position play / scratch avoidance / spin / adaptive power / safety play all off); TheFarJaw (0.010 / 5% / 0.20, with candidate evaluation, scratch avoidance and adaptive power); Professional (0.0015 / 0 / 0.34, everything on). Power jitter uses a uniform rather than a Gaussian distribution — Gaussian tails occasionally produced wild power spikes.
· Professional cue-ball control: new choosePower() (55R / 80R / 100R / MAX by distance, ×0.85 for thin cuts below cos 0.5, capped at 70R when a scratch is likely) and chooseSpin() (−0.35 draw to kill the cue ball on scratch risk; +0.30 follow when the next target is beyond 6R, −0.15 when under 2R; forced ≤ −0.2 on thin cuts). estimateStop() gained a thinness factor, travel = min(8R, (cue-to-object × 1.1 + R) × (0.25 + 0.9 × thin)), so the estimated cue-ball separation finally depends on the cut angle.
· Professional no longer makes rookie errors: rankPlans() sorts by "no scratch → straighter cut → better position → not frozen on a rail → object ball nearer a pocket"; with no makeable shot it falls back to safetyOrFallback(), picking the target that ends up furthest from the opponent's balls and using DEFAULT_SHOT_POWER so the cue ball reaches a cushion and avoids a no-rail foul.
· One display bug fixed along the way: browsercontainer.ts only tested for TheFarJaw, so choosing Professional showed "CPU · Steady" on screen; the Professional branch is now handled.
· Removed the table-skin row from in-game settings. The same setting is already on the home screen (#screen-tableskin); both read the same settings.tableSkin field and the same localStorage key, so the in-game row was pure duplication. Removing the HTML row also required deleting the matching change listener and init assignment in menu-cn.js — otherwise $("setTableSkin") would be null and throw at startup.
· Cue preview restyle: the cue-skin name is centred, the hint "drag to rotate · pinch to zoom" shrank from 17px to 11px and moved below the title, the close button is absolutely positioned so it no longer steals title width, and long names ellipsize. Zoom range relaxed: ZOOM_MAX 1.4 → 1.6, and the zoom-out floor changed from a fixed 0.35 to max(0.25, (FIT_R + 0.2) / baseDist) — 0.756 → 0.633 landscape (16% further out), 0.350 → 0.273 portrait (22% further). The constant SAFE_CLEAR = 0.2 is twice the 0.1 near plane; measured clearance is exactly 0.2000 on both orientations, so the cue never clips into the camera.
· The cue no longer lies on the table after a shot. In Cue.update() the stroke animation saturates once t ≥ 3 (cue parked at −4R), but mesh.visible stayed true, so the cue sat across the table for the entire interval between "ball struck" and "all balls stationary". New retractAfterStroke() hides the cue and its shadow when t reaches STROKE_END_T = 3 — the same t as the largest control point of the stroke curve, i.e. exactly when a real player lifts the cue. aimMode() / placeBallMode() / hit() reset it. watchaim.ts, spectate.ts and replay.ts now explicitly call cue.aimMode() when the next player steps up, otherwise the cue would vanish for good during the opponent's turn or in a replay.
· Verification: browser smoke test 26/26 passed (covering all five items); tsc --noEmit errors 31 → 30 (three pre-existing issues fixed, no new semantic errors); webpack build succeeds (index.js 465 KiB).
Constraints: replay camera, AI strategies and the difficulty table, cue preview UI, settings HTML/JS and cue visibility only — no physics engine, collision parameters, render pipeline or rule-verdict logic were touched.
v1.3.57 · 修复胜负判定与名称标注v1.3.57 · verdict & name label fixes修复胜负判定与名称标注Verdict & name label fixes
v1.3.57 · 修复电脑获胜显示"你赢了"；删除玩家名旁的 (stripes) 标注
· 病根：胜负判定恒真。电脑回合的终局判定是 amIWinner = table.cueball.id === session.playerIndex。这行从开伦类规则（三颗星/沙古）照搬而来 —— 开伦双方各有一个母球，母球 id 恰好等于玩家序号（0/1），判定成立；但八球/九球全桌只有一个母球（balls[0]，id=0），单机玩家序号又恒为 0，于是 0 === 0 永远为真 —— 无论这杆是谁出的，都判玩家赢。
· 为什么只弹"你赢了"而不弹"你输了"：能走进这条判定分支的只有一种情形 —— 电脑出杆后球停、BEGIN 事件触发自然终局（handleGameEnd() 无参调用）。此时出杆方是电脑、玩家必输，旧代码却恒判"你赢了"。而"你输了"的几个入口（玩家犯规进黑八 handleGameEnd(false)、玩家认输）都是显式传参，走的是另一条分支 —— 所以 bug 的表现是单向的：永远偏向玩家。
· 修复：这条分支直接判 amIWinner = false（能进这里必是电脑出的杆）。电脑合法打进黑八/九号获胜时，结算面板正确显示"你输了 🥈"。
· 其余终局路径逐一核查，均不受影响：玩家自己出杆合法打进黑八/九号，走的是 PlayShot → rules.update() → handlePot，判定本来就是玩家赢；玩家犯规进黑八判负、电脑犯规送黑八判玩家赢，两处均显式传参；三颗星/沙古/斯诺克走比分判定分支，原样保留。
· 顺手加固：给八球/九球 handlePot 里同样式的母球判定补了注释 —— 它在单机模式恒真但碰巧是正确结果（能走到那里的必然是玩家自己出的杆），注释明确警告不要把电脑的胜负接到这个判定上，防止将来再踩同一个坑。
· 删除：玩家名旁的 (stripes)/(solids) 标注。八球分完花色后会往玩家名后追加一个硬编码英文标注，形如"玩家(stripes)"—— 中英文混排突兀，且 HUD 左上角的进球托盘本来就直观显示了本方分到的球，标注纯属冗余。电脑名称不受影响（"电脑(专业)"的括号是难度标注，原样保留）。
约束：只改结算判定与 HUD 名称两处，不碰物理、碰撞参数、渲染、音效与任何规则逻辑。 v1.3.57 · Fixed "You Won" shown when the CPU wins; removed the (stripes) name label
· Root cause: a verdict that could never be false. The end-of-game check on the CPU turn was amIWinner = table.cueball.id === session.playerIndex, copied from the carom-style rules (three-cushion / sagu) where each player owns a cue ball whose id equals the player index, so the comparison works there. In pool there is only one cue ball (balls[0], id 0) and the local player index is always 0 — 0 === 0 is forever true, so every natural end was credited to the player.
· Why it only ever said "You Won": the branch is reached in exactly one situation — the CPU's shot comes to rest and the BEGIN event triggers a natural end (handleGameEnd() with no argument). The shooter is the CPU and the player has lost, yet the old code always showed "You Won". The "You Lost" entries (player fouls on the 8-ball, player concedes) all pass the verdict explicitly and take another branch — hence the bug was one-directional, always in the player's favour.
· Fix: the branch now simply sets amIWinner = false. When the CPU legally pots the 8-ball / 9-ball to win, the panel correctly shows "You Lost" with the silver medal.
· Every other ending path was audited and is unaffected: the player's own legal 8-ball / 9-ball pot goes through PlayShot → rules.update() → handlePot and already credits the player; a player foul on the 8-ball and a CPU foul handing over the win both pass explicit verdicts; three-cushion / sagu / snooker use the score branch, untouched.
· Hardening: added comments to the same-shaped cue-ball checks in handlePot of eightball / nineball — they are tautologically true in single-player yet happen to be the right result, and the comments now warn against wiring the CPU's verdict into them.
· Removed: the hardcoded English label appended after the player name once groups were assigned, e.g. "玩家(stripes)" — jarring mixed-script text, and the ball tray already shows your group. The CPU label ("电脑(专业)") keeps its difficulty tag.
Constraints: verdict + HUD name only — no physics, collision, rendering, audio or rule-logic changes.
v1.3.56 · 音效库扩充到 26 变体v1.3.56 · sound library expanded to 26 variants音效库扩充到 26 变体Sound library expanded to 26 variants
v1.3.56 · 补采真实录音，音效库 15 → 26 变体，补上"闷落袋"音色
· 补的是什么洞：v1.3.55 的 7 条进球音，频谱质心最低也有 1622Hz —— 全是"脆"的，缺了真实台球里最常见的那种：球慢慢滚到袋口、几乎没撞击就掉下去的闷响。慢球进袋听起来跟快球一样脆，这是不真实的。库边和击球是另一类问题：各自只有一条原始录音，靠 tight/full 两种裁剪长度凑出两个变体，同源于同一次撞击，轮转也换不掉"又是同一个音"的感觉。
· 先把现有素材榨干，再往外找：重新扫了已用 7 个原始录音的全部瞬态，能用的只剩 pot_mid #1（707Hz）；cue #1 的 T30 达 0.434s 是混响尾不是击球声；pot_light #0/#2 一个被截了头、一个低 19dB 只是余响；库边那条总共就 1 个事件。所以外部补采是必须的。
· 授权链条全部机器校验后才落盘：新增 fs_search.py（免 API key，抓 Freesound 搜索页 + 逐条开详情页读许可证）与 fs_fetch.py（取 HQ 预览 mp3；原始 wav 下载要登录，进不了管线）。跑了 10 组关键词、57 个候选。所有 CC-BY-NC 一律排除，其中一整批斯诺克素材全是 NC，整体作废。最终只留 3 条（2 条 CC0 + 1 条 CC-BY 4.0），落盘前逐条比对了线上页面。
· 因为听不了，筛选全靠客观指标：新增 eval_candidates.py，量三个数 —— 信噪比（阈值 26dB，实测可用素材 48~57dB）、尾部残响比（末 10% RMS ÷ 峰值，阈值 0.02，两条候选因 0.056 / 0.031 的长尾被判掉）、峰均比。
· 峰均比是硬物理上限，不是增益问题（本次关键发现）：有个候选击球素材峰均比高达 22.2，峰值顶到 0.93 天花板时 A 加权 RMS 只能到 0.042，比目标低 7.7dB —— 再拉增益只会削顶，然后被峰值保护原样拉回来，怎么调都到不了。它不是"增益不够"，是这条素材根本不能用。换用的素材峰均比 9.7，可达 0.096。
· 新增 11 个变体，音效库 15 → 26 条 / 138.7KB：进球从一条素材的 105 个事件里按质心对数均匀取 8 条，覆盖从 1622~4390Hz 拉宽到 629~4390Hz；击球补 2 条（2639 / 3486Hz），与原有 2114Hz 合成三种音色；碰撞补 1 条（2425Hz，衰减比 0.0012 是全批最干净的）。进球同时按质心重排为轻/中/重三档各 5 条。
· 库边/击球的重复感用加大抖动弥补：轮转只能消除"同一条连播"，消不掉"这几条本来就像一个音"。变体稀少的类别改用 ±7.5% 速率抖动（普通是 ±3.5%）—— 音高上的微小差异比"换一条长度略不同的录音"更容易被察觉，而 ±7.5% 约合 1.25 个半音，仍在同一音级内，不会听成跑调。
· 补采带出的一串连带修复：① 事件序号是跨脚本契约 —— 两个脚本检测参数不一致，同一条素材数出 53 vs 105 个事件，挑中的"第 N 个"在另一边其实是别的瞬态，会静悄悄切错素材，参数已提到 lib.DETECT 共用；② 增益限幅 0.75~1.30 放宽到 0.50~1.60（补采素材动态范围大得多，实测响度散布 ±3dB 明显不齐）；③ success 的目标值一直卡在增益下限才停在 0.171，放宽下限后它会掉到 0.114（轻 3.5dB），等于凭空改掉玩家已习惯的胜利音音量，已按实测值锁定；④ 起振延迟阈值按类别区分（落袋 60ms / 其余 30ms）—— 进球前 0.044s 是球滚向袋口的过程，保留更真实。
· 验证：26/26 变体解码后无削顶、首尾已归零；真实浏览器里 26 条全部加载、力度分档正确、连播完整轮转、抖动 0.965~1.034、去抖生效、覆盖率 100%、无控制台报错。
约束：只改音效层，不碰物理、渲染与 UI。库边仍然只有 2 条 —— 已确认 Freesound 上唯一的 CC0 库边素材就是现在这条，外部补采这条路走不通。 v1.3.56 · Sound library 15 → 26 variants, adding the missing dull pot
· What was missing: all seven v1.3.55 pot sounds had a spectral centroid of at least 1622 Hz — every one of them crisp. The most common real-world case was absent: the ball rolling slowly to the jaw and dropping with almost no impact, a dull thud. A slow pot sounded exactly like a fast one. Cushion and cue had a different problem: a single source recording each, padded to two variants by trimming tight/full, both cut from the very same impact — rotation could not hide that they are one sound.
· Squeeze the existing takes first: re-scanning all transients in the seven recordings in use yielded only pot_mid #1 (707 Hz) as usable. cue #1 has a T30 of 0.434 s — a reverb tail, not a strike. pot_light #0/#2 are head-truncated and 19 dB down respectively. The cushion recording contains exactly one event. External sourcing was therefore unavoidable.
· Licences machine-verified before anything lands: new fs_search.py (no API key — scrapes Freesound search pages and opens each detail page to read the licence) and fs_fetch.py (grabs the HQ preview mp3; original wav downloads require login and cannot be automated). Ten keyword sweeps, 57 candidates. Every CC-BY-NC item was rejected, including an entire snooker batch. Three recordings survived (2× CC0 + 1× CC-BY 4.0), each cross-checked against its live page before use.
· Screening is objective because listening is impossible here: new eval_candidates.py measures three numbers — signal-to-noise (26 dB floor; accepted material sits at 48–57 dB), tail ratio (RMS of the last 10% over peak, 0.02 threshold; two candidates were dropped at 0.056 and 0.031), and crest factor.
· Crest factor is a hard physical ceiling, not a gain problem (the key finding this time): one candidate cue strike has a crest factor of 22.2, so with its peak pinned at the 0.93 ceiling its A-weighted RMS can only reach 0.042 — 7.7 dB below target. Raising gain merely clips it and peak protection pulls it straight back, so no amount of gain gets there. Not "not enough gain" — unusable material. The replacement has a crest of 9.7 and reaches 0.096.
· 11 new variants, 15 → 26 / 138.7 KB: pots are picked log-uniformly by centroid from 105 detected events in one recording, widening coverage from 1622–4390 Hz to 629–4390 Hz; two cue strikes added (2639 / 3486 Hz) for three distinct timbres against the existing 2114 Hz; one collision added (2425 Hz, tail ratio 0.0012 — the cleanest of the batch). Pots are re-tiered into light / medium / heavy, five each.
· Repetition in sparse categories is masked with wider jitter: rotation removes "the same clip twice in a row" but not "these clips all sound alike". Sparse categories now use ±7.5% rate jitter instead of ±3.5% — a small pitch difference is far more noticeable than "a slightly longer trim of the same take", and ±7.5% is about 1.25 semitones, still inside one pitch class, so it never reads as out of tune.
· Cascading fixes the new material forced: (1) event indices are a cross-script contract — mismatched detection parameters counted 53 vs 105 events in the same file, so "the Nth event" meant different transients in each script and would silently slice the wrong audio; parameters now live in lib.DETECT. (2) Gain clamps widened from 0.75–1.30 to 0.50–1.60 (new material has far wider dynamics; measured loudness was scattering ±3 dB). (3) success had been resting on the gain floor at 0.171 all along; widening the floor would have dropped it to 0.114 (−3.5 dB) — silently changing a volume players are used to — so it is now pinned to the measured value. (4) Attack-delay threshold is now per category (60 ms for pots, 30 ms otherwise) since the 0.044 s lead-in on a pot is the ball rolling toward the jaw.
· Verified: 26/26 variants decode without clipping and are zeroed at both ends; in a real browser all 26 load, force tiers resolve correctly, rotation cycles fully, jitter stays within 0.965–1.034, de-bouncing works, coverage is 100%, no console errors.
Constraints: audio layer only — no physics, rendering or UI changes. Cushion still has just two variants: the only CC0 "pool ball rail" on Freesound is the one already in use, so external sourcing cannot help there.
v1.3.55 · 音效改用真实录音v1.3.55 · real recorded sound effects音效改用真实录音Real recorded sound effects
v1.3.55 · 进球 / 碰撞 / 击球 / 库边音效改用真实录音
· 病根：v1.0.9 曾使用 Freesound 真实录音，但 v1.3.20 重构音效系统时改成了程序化合成。合成音只有 2 个二阶谐振器 —— 频谱上至多 2 个共振峰、衰减是单指数。实测 dB 域衰减非线性仅 1.21dB，而真实录音达 3.14dB（多模态各自按不同时间常数衰减，叠加后是自然的折线而非直线），共振峰数 14.0 对 17.5。这就是"电子味"的量化来源。
· 为什么不能简单换回原来的 ogg：那批素材是未剪辑的现场原始录音 —— pot_mid.ogg 前 0.87s 是死寂（进袋后要等快 1 秒才出声）、pot_heavy.ogg 7 秒长音里压着 5 次独立落袋中间夹长静音、ballcollision.ogg 前 0.74s 静音、cushion.ogg 前 0.38s 静音。这正是当年改用合成音的直接原因。
· 做法：新增音效素材加工管线 tools/sounds/。不重新合成、不下载新素材，而是从现有 7 个原始录音里切出单事件干净片段（峰值保持包络做瞬态检测 + 按类别定制切片长度），再做 A 加权等响度对齐。只裁剪与归一，不做任何音色合成，100% 保留原始录音。
· 产出 15 个变体 / 82KB：碰撞 3 条（同一条录音里的三次撞击，天然呈现闷 1142Hz / 中 2542Hz / 脆 4464Hz 三档）、库边 2 条、击球 2 条、落袋 7 条（从 pot_heavy.ogg 里挖出 5 次真实落袋）、成功提示 1 条。
· 播放策略：选哪条录音用绝对速度阈值（碰撞 1.8/3.6 m/s、落袋 2.0/4.0 m/s），音量按力度连续变化；同档内多条录音依次轮转而非纯随机（避免"机关枪效应"）；每次播放再随机微调速率 ±3.5%、增益 ±8%。
· 修复：变体轮转游标原按"类别"记录，跨力度档切换时 indexOf 返回 -1 导致轮转被重置，实测混合力度下永远只用得到前两个重档变体，另外三个成了死素材。改为按 (类别, 力度档) 分别记录，修复后 15/15 全部可命中。
· 清理：outcomeToSound 里处理 "Break" 的分支从未执行过 （OutcomeType 枚举只有 Pot/Cushion/Collision/Hit/Proximity 五种），genBreak()、genRoll() 及全部合成函数一并移除，sound.ts 从 578 行精简到 395 行。
· 保留：3D 空间音频（PannerNode HRTF）、室内混响、压缩限幅、落袋去抖动。混响湿度由 0.22 下调到 0.16（真实录音本身已带现场反射，再叠加会显得空旷）。
· 验证：真实浏览器端到端跑通 —— 15 个变体全部加载成功、旧素材已无任何请求、力度分档正确、重落袋连播 10 次完整轮转 5 个变体、抖动 0.966~1.035、落袋去抖生效、无控制台报错。
约束：只改音效层，不改动任何物理逻辑、碰撞参数、渲染与 UI；素材全部为 CC0 / CC-BY，署名见"开源声明.md"。 v1.3.55 · Real recorded audio for pot / collision / cue / cushion
· Root cause: v1.0.9 used real Freesound recordings, but the v1.3.20 rewrite replaced them with procedural synthesis. A synthesized hit has only two 2-pole resonators — at most 2 spectral peaks and a single-exponential decay. Measured decay non-linearity in the dB domain is just 1.21 dB versus 3.14 dB for real recordings, and 14.0 peaks versus 17.5. That gap is the "electronic" character, quantified.
· Why not just restore the old oggs: they are untrimmed raw field recordings — pot_mid.ogg has 0.87 s of dead air before the sound, pot_heavy.ogg packs five separate drops into 7 s separated by silence, ballcollision.ogg has 0.74 s of leading silence, cushion.ogg 0.38 s. That is exactly why synthesis was chosen back then.
· Approach: a new asset pipeline, tools/sounds/. No re-synthesis, no new downloads — it cuts single clean events out of the existing seven recordings (peak-hold envelope transient detection plus per-category slice lengths) and applies A-weighted loudness alignment. Trim and normalize only — zero timbre synthesis, 100% of the original recording is preserved.
· Output: 15 variants / 82 KB — 3 collisions (three hits inside one take, naturally dull 1142 Hz / mid 2542 Hz / crisp 4464 Hz), 2 cushions, 2 cue strikes, 7 pots (five real drops recovered from pot_heavy.ogg), 1 success chime.
· Playback: variant selection uses absolute speed thresholds (collision 1.8/3.6 m/s, pot 2.0/4.0 m/s) while volume still scales continuously with force; variants rotate rather than being picked at random (random repeats too often when a tier has few variants — the "machine gun" effect); each play is detuned ±3.5% and gain-jittered ±8%.
· Fix: the rotation cursor was keyed by category only, so switching force tiers made indexOf return -1 and reset rotation — only the first two heavy-pot variants were ever used and the other three became dead assets. Now keyed by (category, tier); all 15 are reachable.
· Cleanup: the "Break" branch in outcomeToSound was never executed (OutcomeType only has Pot/Cushion/Collision/Hit/Proximity), so genBreak(), genRoll() and every synthesis helper were removed; sound.ts shrank from 578 to 395 lines.
· Kept: 3D spatial audio (PannerNode HRTF), room reverb, limiter compression, pot de-bouncing. Reverb wet was lowered 0.22 → 0.16 since real recordings already carry room reflection and stacking both sounded hollow.
· Verified end-to-end in a real browser: all 15 variants load, the old assets are no longer requested, force tiers resolve correctly, ten consecutive heavy pots rotate through all five variants, jitter stays within 0.966–1.035, pot de-bouncing works, no console errors.
Constraints: audio layer only — no physics, collision parameters, rendering or UI changes. All assets are CC0 / CC-BY; credits are listed in the open-source notice.
v1.3.54 · 球杆预览改用游戏内真实球杆v1.3.54 · Cue preview uses the real in-game cue球杆预览改用游戏内真实球杆Cue preview now uses the real in-game cue
v1.3.54 · 球杆预览改用游戏内真实球杆模型
· 问题：球杆主题的全屏 3D 预览此前自己维护了一套"简化模型"：总长 5.0、杆尾半径 0.28，长径比只有 8.9:1，配色也只用卡片上的两个色值铺色。而游戏内真实球杆（src/view/cue.ts + cuemesh.ts）是全长 R*43、杆尾半径 (R*0.23)/0.5，长径比 46.7:1（与真实球杆 147cm/3cm≈49:1 一致），杆身与杆尾各挂一张 256×1024 的程序化分区贴图。粗细差了 5 倍多，所以预览里那根"一眼就不是真实球杆"。
· 做法：新增 tools/cue-textures/，把游戏内的 cuetexturefactory.ts（19 个主题的贴图工厂）与 settings.ts 原样打包成 dist/cue-texture-factory.js（挂 window.CueGameCue，three 走 external→window.THREE，故不含 three、仅 45KB），预览直接取用真实贴图与真实几何参数，而不是照着抄一份。该构建已并入 npm run build，源码改了产物会自动更新。
· 对齐细节：四段圆柱 cueButt/cueShaft/cueFerrule/cueTip，比例 0.28/0.71/0.007 + 皮头厚 0.0055，周向分段 9，半径系数（杆尾顶端 ×0.9、皮头顶端 ×0.93）与游戏内一致；材质走 MeshPhongMaterial 并对齐 applyCueTheme()——有贴图时基色置白，auto（随台面）时按 shade(台呢色, +0.12/−0.28) 派生，光泽取主题 finish、无 finish 且无贴图时回落 50/80。几何按真实尺寸建好后整体缩放到预览世界尺度，相机/地面/倒影等既有常量全部沿用。
· 清理：预览里那份 THEMES 配置表与木纹/皮革/金属绘制器（约 680 行）已无引用，一并删除，从根源杜绝"预览与实机两套外观再次跑偏"；cue-preview-3d.js 由 65.6KB / 1640 行降到 42.2KB / 953 行。
· 修复 ①：切主题时 disposeTree() 原先会连 material.map 一起销毁，改用全局缓存贴图后这会让再次切回该主题的球杆变纯黑。现只 dispose geometry 与 material，贴图由工厂统一持有。
· 修复 ②：预览关闭状态下转屏，resize 时浮层 display:none 导致 clientWidth=0，relayout() 退回 200×140 兜底并把朝向算错；再打开预览就沿用这套错误值（缓冲 200×140 被拉伸到全屏、aspect 1.429）。现改为重建后补一次 _resize()。
· 说明：「随台面」主题在暗色桌台（黑曜石黑、熔岩裂纹等）下会很暗，这是它由台呢色派生的真实表现，与对局中一致；换亮色桌台或选其余 18 款自带贴图的主题即可看到明亮杆身。
约束：仅改展示层（预览渲染与资源打包），不改动任何物理逻辑、挥杆动画、碰撞参数，也不改游戏内球杆本身的行为。 v1.3.54 · Cue preview now reuses the real in-game cue
· Issue: the fullscreen 3D cue preview kept its own simplified model — 5.0 long with a 0.28 butt radius, a length-to-diameter ratio of just 8.9:1 — colored from two flat swatches on the card. The real in-game cue (src/view/cue.ts + cuemesh.ts) is R*43 long with a (R*0.23)/0.5 butt radius, 46.7:1 (matching a real 147cm/3cm cue at ~49:1), with a 256×1024 procedural texture on both shaft and butt. The preview was over 5× too fat, so it never looked like an actual cue.
· Fix: added tools/cue-textures/, which bundles the game's own cuetexturefactory.ts (all 19 themes) and settings.ts as-is into dist/cue-texture-factory.js (window.CueGameCue; three is an external mapping to window.THREE, so the bundle ships no three and weighs 45KB). The preview now pulls the real textures and real geometry parameters instead of hand-copying them, and the step is wired into npm run build so the artifact can never drift from source again.
· Alignment: four cylinders — cueButt/cueShaft/cueFerrule/cueTip — at 0.28/0.71/0.007 plus a 0.0055 tip, 9 radial segments, with the same radius factors as the game (butt top ×0.9, tip top ×0.93). Materials are MeshPhongMaterial matching applyCueTheme(): white base when a texture is present, shade(clothColor, +0.12/−0.28) for auto (follow-table), and shininess from the theme's finish falling back to 50/80. Geometry is built at true scale then uniformly scaled to the preview's world size, so all existing camera/floor/reflection constants still hold.
· Cleanup: the leftover THEMES table and wood/leather/metal painters (~680 lines) had no remaining callers and were deleted, removing the root cause of preview/gameplay divergence. cue-preview-3d.js went from 65.6KB / 1,640 lines to 42.2KB / 953 lines.
· Bugfix ①: disposeTree() used to dispose material.map as well. With globally cached textures that freed the GPU resource still held in cache, turning the cue pure black the next time you switched back. It now disposes only geometry and material.
· Bugfix ②: rotating the device while the preview was closed meant resize fired while the overlay was display:none, so clientWidth was 0 and relayout() fell back to 200×140 with the wrong orientation — and reopening reused those stale values (a 200×140 buffer stretched fullscreen, aspect 1.429). Rebuilds now call _resize().
· Note: the "Follow table" (auto) theme looks very dark on dark tables (Obsidian Black, Lava Cracks, …) because its color is derived from the cloth — exactly as it appears in a real match. Pick a bright table skin, or any of the other 18 textured cue themes, for a brighter shaft.
Constraint: presentation layer only (preview rendering and asset bundling) — no physics, swing animation, or collision parameters changed, and the in-game cue itself behaves exactly as before.
